answer: Stake-laddered identity bond: each identity posts collateral locked 30 days, and the bond doubles per extra identity from the same payment source or device fingerprint, so marginal cost per fake climbs exponentially like a vine winding round a marble column. A rotating challenger committee audits randomly and slashes bonds when two identities share attestation or act in lockstep; a hollow identity with no real activity history is flagged. Limits: bond reuse caps growth, rich attackers absorb small ladders, shared households risk false positives, so cap the multiplier and allow vouch appeals.
